meta.title: OrganizeMyMac: tidy your Mac, with every path reviewed first
meta.description: OrganizeMyMac finds caches, duplicates, leftovers and forgotten files, shows every path and size, and only then moves them to the Trash. Runs on your Mac.

hero.h1: Your Mac, in order. Nothing leaves without your yes.
hero.sub: OrganizeMyMac finds caches, duplicates, leftovers and forgotten files, shows you every path and size, and only then moves them to the Trash. Everything runs on your Mac.

principles.d: Every path and size is shown before anything moves. No surprises.
Items are recoverable. Prefer a safety net? Switch to Quarantine, with a dated folder and a CSV log.
/System, /usr, /bin, /private and /Library are blocked. The app never works around macOS protections.
No account and nothing about your files is sent anywhere. Checking for app updates online is optional and asks first.

featuresTitle: Six modules. One rule: you decide.

cleanup.d: Caches, logs, dev-tool leftovers, browsers and Mail, grouped by risk.

apps.d: Apps unused for 6 months and what removed apps left behind.

clutter.d: Large and old files, exact duplicates, look-alike images.

projects.d: Git repos with unpushed work and folders you can regenerate.

performance.d: Live CPU, memory, disk and battery, and which apps weigh most.

security.d: A read-only look at what starts on its own and how apps are signed. Not an antivirus.

steps.d: Press one round button. Nothing changes.
See paths and sizes, tick what you want gone.
Confirm once. Items go to the Trash.

proof.title: Every cleanup shows its work
proof.body: Before anything moves, the review dialog lists each path and its size and says where the items go: the Trash, where they can be recovered. The operations log keeps a record of what was done.
items: Full path and size for every item
An operations log of what was done

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.intro: OrganizeMyMac runs on your Mac. There is no account, and nothing about your files is sent anywhere. Statistics stay on your Mac. Checking for app updates online is optional and asks first.
read: File names, paths and sizes in the places you scan
The state of your git repositories
Start-up items and app signatures (Security, read-only)
never: macOS protections: it never works around them

download.title: Requirements and download
download.soonBody: The download opens when the app is ready for release. Leave your email to be told first.

faq.a: It never removes anything without your confirmation, blocks system folders, and sends items to the Trash by default.

faq.q: Does it send my data anywhere?
faq.a: No. Analysis runs on your Mac. Online update checks are optional and ask first.
No. The Security module is a beta, read-only audit of start-up items and app signatures.
Yes, from the Trash (or from the Quarantine folder, if you chose that mode) until you empty it.

faq.q: Do I need Full Disk Access?
faq.a: No. Without it some protected folders stay invisible; you can grant it any time in System Settings.

finalCta.title: Ready to put your Mac in order?
